newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners biggest yen bond buyers in May--JSDA.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners biggest yen bond buyers in May--JSDA.

text.p: Foreign investors continued to be the biggest buyers of yen bonds in May, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Friday.
Foreign investors' net yen bond purchases in May totalled 2.5484 trillion yen, down from a record high of 5.1777 trillion yen in April.
The bulk of foreigners' buying, or 2.4951 trillion yen, was in short-term bonds.
The figures include Japanese government bonds, notes and Treasury bills, corporate bonds and bank debentures, the JSDA said.
